description: Index data into Elasticsearch or query ES and write results to a database table.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Dagster asset key for this component.

elasticsearch_url_env_var.label: Elasticsearch Url Env Var
elasticsearch_url_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the Elasticsearch URL (e.g. ``http://localhost:9200`` or an Elastic Cloud endpoint).

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the Elastic Cloud API key. Leave unset for unauthenticated or username/password-based clusters.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Operation mode. ``index`` bulk-indexes documents from an upstream Dagster asset DataFrame; ``query`` runs a DSL query and writes hits to a database table.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset key of the upstream asset providing a pandas DataFrame. In ``index`` mode the DataFrame rows are indexed as ES documents. In ``query`` mode this field is optional (lineage only; the upstream value is not used). Mutually exclusive with `source` in ``index`` mode.

source.label: SQL Source
source.description: Pull rows directly via SQL instead of from an upstream asset: {kind: warehouse_query, resource_key: <registered resource> OR database_url_env_var: <env var>, sql: <query>}. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key` -- set exactly one.

id_field.label: Id Field
id_field.description: Column/field to use as the Elasticsearch document ``_id``. If omitted, Elasticsearch auto-generates IDs.

chunk_size.label: Chunk Size
chunk_size.description: Number of documents per bulk-index request in ``index`` mode.

query.label: Query
query.description: JSON string representing the Elasticsearch query DSL body sent in ``query`` mode. Defaults to ``{}`` which Elasticsearch treats as ``match_all``. In a partitioned asset, {partition_key}, {partition_date}, {partition_start} and {partition_end} are replaced with the partition's values (for example a range filter on its dates).

database_url_env_var.label: Database Url Env Var
database_url_env_var.description: Env var containing a SQLAlchemy-compatible database URL. Used as the destination in ``query`` mode.

table_name.label: Table Name
table_name.description: Destination table name for ``query`` mode results.

if_exists.label: If Exists
if_exists.description: Behaviour when the destination table already exists in ``query`` mode. One of: ``replace``, ``append``, ``fail``.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current date partition key (e.g. 'event_date', 'created_at').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current static partition value (e.g. 'customer_id', 'region').

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage, emitted as `dagster/column_lineage` metadata on every materialization: {output column: [upstream columns]}, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}. The upstream asset is `upstream_asset_key`, or the only entry of `deps`; with several upstream assets, name each column '<asset_key>:<column>'. Ignored with a warning when no upstream asset can be resolved.

include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the data being written / produced in metadata, so builder UIs can show output shape without warehouse access.
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows in the preview when include_preview_metadata=True. Random sample if len > 10x preview_rows; else head.
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.
description.label: Description

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run (the row-filter logic already handles a multi-partition range correctly). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set. 'single_run' requires a partition-range-aware IO manager (e.g. a DB-table IO manager with partition_expr set) -- a generic filesystem/default IO manager cannot persist a single_run output spanning multiple partitions and will raise a clear error at materialization time.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).
